params.name: chainId
params.description: Chain ID of the network. Use 1 for Ethereum, 42161 for Arbitrum One, 8453 for Base.

params.name: contractAddress
params.description: Ethereum address of the Art Blocks core contract.

items.docs: Returns an HTML page containing the live generative artwork for a given token, suitable for embedding in an iframe. The page executes the artist's on-chain script in the browser using the token's deterministic hash as the PRNG seed. This is the canonical live view of the artwork as defined by the on-chain contract.
